title: Equal-and-opposite internal transfer conservation
contract: transfer_to_groundwater is positive into MODFLOW storage and is applied with the exact opposite sign to the internal memory ledger; it is not an external source.
gates: groundwater storage change equals transfer within 1e-12 m
memory change equals minus transfer within 1e-12 m
combined groundwater-plus-memory state change is zero within 1e-12 m in both directions
forbidden: do not reinterpret an internal transfer as net system recharge or loss
